name: Mexico
title: Holidays in Mexico
intro: Caribbean beaches, cenotes, ruins and amazing food. Here's where to go on holiday in Mexico, and the best time to visit.
seo_title: Where to go in Mexico: the best places for a holiday

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Mexico?
faqs.answer: December to April is dry season for most of Mexico, and the best time for Cancún, Bacalar and Oaxaca.

faqs.question: Where in Mexico is good for a beach holiday?
faqs.answer: Cancún has the Caribbean beaches, and Bacalar has a calm, bright-blue lagoon a few hours south.

faqs.question: Is Mexico City worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes. It has some of the best food and museums in the world, and is at its best in spring and autumn.
